# BeautyFit Promotional Video - Shot List & Prompts

Use each image below as a reference frame for image-to-video (i2v) generation. Pair each image with its corresponding prompt.

---

## Shot 1: Confusion at the Vanity
**Timestamp:** 00:00 - 00:03  
**Image:** shot1-confused-woman-vanity-makeup.png  
**Visual Prompt (i2v):** Cinematic close-up, a young woman sits at a cluttered vanity table overflowing with makeup products. She looks confused and overwhelmed, gently touching her cheek. Warm golden side lamp casts dramatic shadows across her face. Shallow depth of field with soft bokeh in the mirror reflection behind her.  
**Motion & Camera:** Slow dolly-in toward her face. She sighs softly, picks up a lipstick, hesitates, then puts it back down. Subtle head tilt expressing uncertainty.  
**Audio:** Soft melancholic piano note, ambient room tone, gentle rustling of makeup brushes.

---

## Shot 2: Discovering the App
**Timestamp:** 00:03 - 00:06  
**Image:** shot2-phone-upload-selfie-app.png  
**Visual Prompt (i2v):** Overhead close-up of elegant fingers tapping a sleek dark smartphone screen. The BeautyFit app interface glows with gold accents, showing an "Upload Photo" button. A selfie is being selected. Soft screen glow illuminates the fingertips against a dark marble surface.  
**Motion & Camera:** Static top-down shot. Finger taps the upload button, a loading animation appears on screen, the selfie thumbnail slides into place. Subtle light pulse from the screen.  
**Audio:** Soft tap sound effect, gentle digital chime confirming upload, ambient electronic hum building anticipation.

---

## Shot 3: AI Face Analysis
**Timestamp:** 00:06 - 00:10  
**Image:** shot3-ai-face-analysis-mesh-points.png  
**Visual Prompt (i2v):** Futuristic visualization of AI analyzing a female face. 478 glowing blue-green and rose-gold geometric landmark points appear one by one, connected by luminous mesh lines forming a precise 3D facial map. Dark blue-black background with floating holographic data streams on both sides. High-tech sci-fi aesthetic.  
**Motion & Camera:** Slow zoom-out revealing the full face mesh. Points illuminate sequentially from center outward like a wave. Data streams flow vertically on the sides. The mesh rotates slightly in 3D space.  
**Audio:** Futuristic scanning sound effects (soft beeps, digital processing), rising synthesizer tone building excitement, subtle bass pulse.

---

## Shot 4: Results Reveal
**Timestamp:** 00:10 - 00:14  
**Image:** shot4-results-elegant-score-screen.png  
**Visual Prompt (i2v):** Premium app results screen animating into view. Large "Elegant" text appears in purple-to-gold gradient with a shimmer effect. Six style dimension score bars (Classic, Natural, Dramatic, Romantic, Creative, Elegant) fill up sequentially with smooth animations. Dark elegant background with floating bokeh particles.  
**Motion & Camera:** Static frame with UI animation. Text fades in with a golden sparkle, score bars fill from left to right one after another, particles drift upward gently. Final score highlights with a glow pulse.  
**Audio:** Satisfying reveal sound (ascending chime sequence), each bar filling creates a soft "tick" sound, triumphant subtle orchestral swell at the end.

---

## Shot 5: Confident Transformation
**Timestamp:** 00:14 - 00:18  
**Image:** shot5-confident-woman-makeup-mirror.png  
**Visual Prompt (i2v):** Medium shot of a confident young woman smiling radiantly while applying rose-colored lipstick in front of a professional ring light mirror. A smartphone nearby displays her personalized color palette. Bright, warm, empowering atmosphere in a beauty studio with soft diffused lighting.  
**Motion & Camera:** Slow arc movement around her (slight orbit right). She applies lipstick with a confident smile, glances at the phone palette, nods approvingly, then looks directly at camera with a warm, empowered expression.  
**Audio:** Uplifting pop music building to chorus, soft makeup application sounds, confident exhale.

---

## Shot 6: Brand Card & CTA
**Timestamp:** 00:18 - 00:22  
**Image:** shot6-brand-card-beautyfit-gold.png  
**Visual Prompt (i2v):** Pure black background. "BeautyFit" text materializes in luxurious gold gradient with metallic sheen. Delicate sparkle particles and gold dust float and drift around the text. Below appears "Your AI Beauty Specialist" in elegant white serif. At the bottom fades in "beautyfit.online | Try Free Analysis" in subtle gray. Premium, high-end beauty brand aesthetic.  
**Motion & Camera:** Static frame with text animation. "BeautyFit" fades in with a golden shimmer sweep left-to-right. Particles continuously drift upward. Tagline fades in 1 second after. URL appears last with a subtle pulse.  
**Audio:** Elegant brand sting (soft harp + synth pad), sparkle sound effects, final resonant tone that fades to silence.

## Production Notes

- **Total Duration:** ~22 seconds (can be extended to 30s by slowing transitions)
- **Aspect Ratio:** 16:9 (1024x576 source images)
- **Recommended i2v Models:** wan2.6-i2v, veo-3.1-generate-001, or seedance-1-5-pro
- **Color Grading:** Warm golden tones for shots 1, 2, 5; Cool blue-tech for shots 3, 4; Pure black/gold for shot 6
- **Music Style:** Modern cinematic pop with electronic elements, building from melancholic to empowering
